name: greenswamp-babylon-build
description: Builds the tree-shaken Babylon.js bundle used by the TelescopeView 3D page.

scripts.build: esbuild src/entry.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --legal-comments=none --banner:js="/* Babylon.js 9.27.0 (Apache-2.0) tree-shaken build - see tools/babylon-build */" --outfile=../../GreenSwamp.Alpaca.Server/wwwroot/lib/babylon/babylon.slim.js
